coverage.summary: Applies citywide to all residential rental property in the City of San Diego and its landlords. No unit-count, construction-date or owner-occupancy limits are stated.
coverage.other_conditions: Residential rental property is defined by incorporating S.D. Mun. Code § 98.0702: any dwelling or unit intended for human habitation, including any dwelling or unit in a mobilehome park.

result.notes: Division 11 borrows only the definitions in § 98.0702. It does not borrow the § 98.0703 exemptions, which apply only to 'this Division' (Division 7). So the just-cause exemptions (certificate of occupancy within 15 years, owner-occupied duplex, single-family homes, affordable housing and so on) do not limit this rule. The two exclusions in § 98.1102 (historical or public-data reports, and affordable-housing program rent-setting software) narrow the definition of 'algorithmic device'. They concern the software used, not which buildings are covered, so they are not listed as building exemptions. The ordinance is still a draft whose final passage is not shown.
